grading_standard: Correct requires every requested material part, no material contradiction, and summary support. Partial is material omission/abstention without wrong ruling; Incorrect is any material contradiction. Equivalent wording/clear implications accepted. No unasked key extras required; no cross-answer borrowing; answer quotes count but evidence alone does not fill answers. Confidence/self-review ignored.

Primary first, then Bombay/Madras/Bengal; Commander selects intra-Presidency order.
Normal primary strength plus target unrest.
Foreign primary ordinary attack die without unrest.
Secondary strength only local unrest, no event modifier/empire strength.
Commander acts, otherwise Military Affairs, otherwise Chairman.
Substitutes gain/lose no trophies; occupied Commander has normal trophies.
Must exhaust active pieces equal to Crisis strength or as many as possible.
Alliances printed strength once and cannot split across purposes.
Printed equality means attack failure/defense success; non-equality means attack success/defense failure.
Successful defense removes all target unrest and awards actual Commander one trophy.
Defeated normal primary Invasion also loses one attacker tower if possible.
Failed defense causes Region Loss and successful primary Invasion applies empire creation/growth.
Excess indivisible alliance counting remains unresolved; no verified >= ruling.
